#LSPUAnnouncement | 𝗧𝗲𝗺𝗽𝗼𝗿𝗮𝗿𝘆 𝗔𝗹𝘁𝗲𝗿𝗻𝗮𝘁𝗶𝘃𝗲 𝗗𝗿𝗲𝘀𝘀 𝗖𝗼𝗱𝗲, (𝗟𝗦𝗣𝗨-𝗨𝗻𝗶𝘃𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗶𝘁𝘆-𝘄𝗶𝗱𝗲)

To ensure students’ comfort amid warmer conditions, LSPU will temporarily allow an alternative dress code for the Type A uniform from Monday to Friday, effective immediately until the end of the First Semester of Academic Year 2026–2027.

𝙪𝙥𝙥𝙚𝙧 𝙖𝙩𝙩𝙞𝙧𝙚
- white shirt with minimal print, short or long sleeves
- officially recognized LSPU attire (e.g., organizational shirt, college shirt)

𝙡𝙤𝙬𝙚𝙧 𝙖𝙩𝙩𝙞𝙧𝙚
- slacks, denim, and other decent pants

Alternative attire must comply with the University’s dress code.

Reference: Approved request of the Federated Supreme Student Council

Congratulations and best of luck, LSPU CHED-HUSAY Scholars!

Ms. Carolyn Marie L. Bonsol and Ms. Hazel Olive S. San Juan, faculty members of the Laguna State Polytechnic University (LSPU), earned scholarships under the Commission on Higher Education (CHED) Higher Education Upskilling and Study for Advancement of Staff and Faculty (HUSAY) Program and are currently undergoing specialized graduate training in Thailand.

From November 9 to December 3, 2026, the two faculty members are joining the other 58 higher education scholars across the country to participate in the second phase of the micro-credential program titled “Strengthening the Future of Food Systems: Specialized Graduate Training in Food Innovation, Nutrition, and Bioprocessing” at the Asian Institute of Technology (AIT) in Thailand.

See also: https://lspu.edu.ph/news/lspu-ched-husay-scholars-head-to-thailand-for-food-innovation-training

#LSPUWhereLeadersBegin

title: Be part of the Ka-Peer Yu, mga ka-piyu! 💙
raw_caption: Be part of the Ka-Peer Yu, mga ka-piyu! 💙𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗲𝗮𝗿𝘀 𝘁𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗹𝗶𝘀𝘁𝗲𝗻, 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗵𝗲𝗮𝗿𝘁 𝘁𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘂𝗻𝗱𝗲𝗿𝘀𝘁𝗮𝗻𝗱𝘀, 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗣𝗲𝗲𝗿 𝗔𝗱𝘃𝗼𝗰𝗮𝘁𝗲 𝘄𝗵𝗼 𝘄𝗮𝗹𝗸𝘀 𝗯𝗲𝘀𝗶𝗱𝗲 𝘆𝗼𝘂. Ka-Peer Yu is LSPU’s dedicated peer advocate organization, fostering a safe, inclusive, and judgment-free space where every Ka-Piyu feels heard and valued. At our heart is volunteerism—standing alongside our peers through academic and personal challenges without discrimination. 𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗪𝗲 𝗢𝗳𝗳𝗲𝗿: 💙 Peer Support & Listening – A safe space to talk and be understood. 💙 Mental Health Advocacy – Awareness campaigns and seminars building student resilience. 💙 Workshops & Volunteerism – Interactive activities empowering our campus community.
